name: Each news card has a readable article title
description: Every news card in the Related News panel should display a title that describes the article content. Cards without titles or with only placeholder text fail this test.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Verify that the first visible news card shows a readable article title — a headline-like string of at least 10 characters that is not 'Untitled', 'Article Title', or other placeholder text
